policy: All 165 original-wording English nonfoil-available printings inventoried; 156 accepted single-face scans scored with frozen independent scan-only poses. Six rejected single faces and three splits excluded. Component-weighted edge similarity includes title, mana, type, rules, expansion symbol, P/T, artist/legal, art and frame. Four corner regions and the separate full-raster diagnostic composite alpha over identical neutral gray so corner shape is visible. No scan-assisted art or per-card renderer parameters. Original wording includes reviewed printing corrections recorded in the captured input hashes. Colors are excluded from structural rank and documented in separate pigment reports. These indices are not percentages of correct pixels and do not certify flawless typography. This offline region map is not yet deployed to the review app.
